arts.ttl: "For other people to judge" - Slot addresses Liverpool future following PSV humbling
arts.sum: Liverpool head coach Arne Slot addresses sack rumours following Wednesday's heavy 4-1 defeat to PSV Eindhoven in the Champions League.

arts.ttl: ‘I’m feeling safe’: Arne Slot insists he retains Liverpool’s support after PSV humiliation
arts.sum: Club on worst run since 1953-54 after 4-1 rout ‘I have got a lot of support from above’ Arne Slot said it was understandable that questions were being asked over his future as Liverpool head coach, but he insisted he retained the support of the club’s hierarchy following another heavy defeat, this time against PSV Eindhoven. Liverpool fell to a ninth defeat in 12 games, the club’s worst run since being relegated in 1953-54, as they were picked apart by the Eredivisie champions on a punishing night at Anfield. Liverpool last lost three successive games by a three-goal margin or more in December 1953. Continue reading...

arts.ttl: Liverpool's 'lack of intensity' exposed by PSV
